import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n

    oo = 10**9
    size = 1 << n
    # initialize curr with oo, except curr[0][0] = 0? Actually Arrays.fill(curr[0], 0) sets all entries in row 0 to 0.
    # So curr[0][j] = 0 for all j.
    curr = [[oo] * size for _ in range(size)]
    for j in range(size):
        curr[0][j] = 0

    for j in range(m):
        next_arr = [[oo] * size for _ in range(size)]
        limit_c2 = 1 if j == m - 1 else size
        for c0 in range(size):
            row_c0 = curr[c0]
            for c1 in range(size):
                val = row_c0[c1]
                if val == oo:
                    continue
                for c2 in range(limit_c2):
                    all_mask = size - 1
                    done = (all_mask & (c1 >> 1)) | (all_mask & (c1 << 1)) | c0 | c2
                    done &= (all_mask ^ c1)
                    new_val = val + n - done.bit_count()
                    if new_val < next_arr[c1][c2]:
                        next_arr[c1][c2] = new_val
        curr = next_arr

    res = oo
    for i in range(size):
        for j in range(size):
            if curr[i][j] < res:
                res = curr[i][j]

    print(n * m - res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
